# Traffic Manager
> Traffic Manager provides traffic exchange, monetization, and ad-serving tools for publishers and advertisers.

Traffic Manager offers a web platform focused on traffic buying, selling, tracking, and monetization workflows, with product pages, platform features, and support resources for users managing online advertising operations.

## Main
- [Home](https://trafficmanager.net/): Overview of the platform, products, and traffic monetization capabilities.
- [About](https://trafficmanager.net/about): Company background and summary of Traffic Manager’s advertising technology services.
- [Contact](https://trafficmanager.net/contact): Contact information and inquiry form for sales or general questions.
- [Support](https://trafficmanager.net/support): Entry point for customer assistance and platform-related help.
- [Login](https://trafficmanager.net/login): User access page for existing Traffic Manager account holders.
- [Register](https://trafficmanager.net/register): Account creation page for new publishers, advertisers, or partners.

## Products
- [Publishers](https://trafficmanager.net/publishers): Product information for publishers looking to monetize website or app traffic.
- [Advertisers](https://trafficmanager.net/advertisers): Product information for advertisers buying traffic and managing campaigns.
- [Ad Exchange](https://trafficmanager.net/ad-exchange): Overview of exchange functionality for buying and selling traffic inventory.
- [Smartlinks](https://trafficmanager.net/smartlinks): Information about smartlink monetization and automated offer routing.
- [Popunder](https://trafficmanager.net/popunder): Details on popunder ad formats and traffic monetization options.
- [Push Notifications](https://trafficmanager.net/push-notifications): Information about push traffic and notification-based advertising formats.

## Platform Features
- [Tracking](https://trafficmanager.net/tracking): Overview of traffic tracking, reporting, and campaign performance monitoring.
- [Targeting](https://trafficmanager.net/targeting): Description of audience and campaign targeting capabilities.
- [Optimization](https://trafficmanager.net/optimization): Information on tools for improving campaign performance and ROI.
- [Real-Time Statistics](https://trafficmanager.net/real-time-statistics): Details on live reporting and performance analytics features.
- [Fraud Protection](https://trafficmanager.net/fraud-protection): Information about traffic quality controls and anti-fraud measures.
- [API](https://trafficmanager.net/api): Overview of integration options and programmatic platform access.

## Solutions
- [Monetization](https://trafficmanager.net/monetization): Information on monetizing traffic through Traffic Manager products.
- [Traffic Buying](https://trafficmanager.net/traffic-buying): Overview of tools and workflows for purchasing advertising traffic.
- [Traffic Selling](https://trafficmanager.net/traffic-selling): Overview of selling traffic inventory through the platform.
- [Campaign Management](https://trafficmanager.net/campaign-management): Information on creating, managing, and optimizing ad campaigns.
- [Affiliate Marketing](https://trafficmanager.net/affiliate-marketing): Details on affiliate-focused traffic and monetization use cases.
- [Media Buying](https://trafficmanager.net/media-buying): Information for media buyers using the platform to acquire traffic.
